artifact.name: knix.img
artifact.role: GPT disk with a 512 MiB FAT32 EFI system partition and an ext4 root; native rootfs, self-built 7.2.15 kernel, 770 modules, guest-owned initramfs and systemd-boot

seed.name: debian-13-generic-arm64.qcow2
seed.role: one-time package source and helper boot; not a product capability source

build_stages: platform/image/build-kernel.sh --apply (inside the arm64 Linux build guest)
platform/image/build-rootfs.sh --apply (inside the arm64 Linux build guest)
platform/image/build.sh --build (on the host; assembles, boots, verifies, writes the receipt)
verification: uname -m is aarch64 and uname -r is 7.2.15
/lib/modules/7.2.15 carries the recorded module count and modules.dep
modprobe loads a module without vermagic or unknown-symbol errors
4 brand assets are byte-identical to docs/brand/
no cloud-init state, no seed bootloader, no failed units
boots from its own EFI system partition with no -kernel, no seed ISO and no EFI boot variables
identity survives a cold boot; serial console and ssh remain available without a GPU

boot.esp: 512 MiB FAT32 on /dev/vda1; removable path EFI/BOOT/BOOTAA64.EFI

receipt: platform/image/build.sh writes $KNIX_DEV_DIR/BUILD-RECEIPT.json with the artifact sha256 and every build input digest
